comment: Justified exceptions for tools/wl-conformance.mjs. Keys: <interface>.<request> under requests, <interface>.<event> under events, <interface>.error.<name> under errors, <global>/<check-id> under dynamic; the value is the reason, shown in the report. An allowed check counts as passed. Only for what the protocol itself allows (a hint the compositor may ignore, an event it never needs to send); never to hide a gap.

requests.wl_surface.set_opaque_region: An optimization hint the protocol lets the compositor ignore; lord-server composites every surface with its alpha.
requests.wl_data_offer.accept@offer_impl: accept is drag-and-drop feedback (which mime type would be taken on drop); on a selection offer it has no meaning and the protocol defines no error for it.
requests.zwp_locked_pointer_v1.set_cursor_positio: 'A compositor may use this information to warp the pointer upon unlock': optional; lord-server leaves the pointer where it was locked.
requests.zwp_text_input_v3.set_text_change_cause: Informational double-buffered state for the input method; LordOS's input method composes the same whatever the cause, so ignoring it changes nothing a client can see.
requests.wp_image_description_creator_icc_v1.set_: color-management-v1 makes ICC profiles an optional feature (wp_color_manager_v1.feature.icc_v2_v4). lord-server doesn't advertise it (it has no ICC parser; parametric descriptions, named primaries and transfer functions are supported), so create_icc_creator raises unsupported_feature, as the protocol says, and no ICC creator or ICC-based description can exist.
requests.wp_image_description_creator_icc_v1.crea: color-management-v1 makes ICC profiles an optional feature (wp_color_manager_v1.feature.icc_v2_v4). lord-server doesn't advertise it (it has no ICC parser; parametric descriptions, named primaries and transfer functions are supported), so create_icc_creator raises unsupported_feature, as the protocol says, and no ICC creator or ICC-based description can exist.

events.zwp_tablet_pad_group_v2.modes: tablet-v2: 'This event is only sent when more than one mode is available.' lord-server gives each pad group one mode (it has no libwacom data to know which button switches modes), so the event must not be sent; mode_switch with mode 0 follows every enter, as the protocol asks.
events.wp_image_description_info_v1.icc_file: color-management-v1 makes ICC profiles an optional feature (wp_color_manager_v1.feature.icc_v2_v4). lord-server doesn't advertise it (it has no ICC parser; parametric descriptions, named primaries and transfer functions are supported), so create_icc_creator raises unsupported_feature, as the protocol says, and no ICC creator or ICC-based description can exist.

errors.xdg_wm_base.error.unresponsive: xdg_wm_base.ping: 'It's unspecified what will happen if the client doesn't respond to the ping request ... The unresponsive error is provided for compositors that wish to disconnect unresponsive clients.' Optional; like Mutter and KWin, lord-server pings (on focus) and logs an app that doesn't answer, but never disconnects it (a busy app would lose its work).
errors.wp_presentation.error.invalid_timestamp: No request of presentation-time carries a timestamp: the error can't be triggered by a client.
errors.wp_presentation.error.invalid_flag: No request of presentation-time carries flags: the error can't be triggered by a client.

dynamic.xdg_wm_base/popup.grab_denied: xdg_popup.grab: 'If the compositor denies the grab, the popup will be immediately dismissed' — denying a grab with a stale serial is the compositor's choice, not a requirement; lord-server grants it to the focused client.
